name: qwbe
description: Qwbe -- kernel that discovers cubes from disk. One cube = one directory; installing it touches no existing file.

scripts.probe:staging: node probes/staging.mjs && node probes/staging-life.mjs && node probes/staging-proofs.mjs && node probes/staging-perf.mjs
scripts.probe:booktags-migration: node probes/booktags-migration.mjs && node probes/booktags-migration-ownership.mjs && node probes/booktags-migration-ledger.mjs
scripts.probe:all: npm run probe:store && npm run probe:smoke && npm run probe:staging && npm run probe:customfields && npm run probe:booktags && npm run probe:contract && npm run probe:list && npm run probe:cube-metadata && npm run probe:permissions && npm run probe:agent-surface && npm run probe:booktags-migration && npm run probe:security && npm run probe:external-auth && npm run probe:auth-logout && npm run probe:restart && npm run probe:drift && npm run probe:admin-restart && npm run probe:decoupling && npm run probe:install && npm run probe:install-from && npm run probe:check && npm run probe:lifecycle
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run probe:all
scripts.e2e: NEXT_PUBLIC_QWBE_API=http://127.0.0.1:4520 npm --prefix web run build && playwright test
scripts.probe:store: node probes/store.mjs && node probes/store-isolation.mjs && node probes/store-migration.mjs

engines._comment: 22.18 is where TypeScript type-stripping stopped needing a flag. `npm test` runs .ts files directly and `npm run api` has always done the same, so the old >=22.5.0 was already understating what this repository needs.
